title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Carbon-aerogel adsorption selectivity depends jointly on pore architecture, surface charge, functional groups, and adsorbate chemistry.
explanation: The review describes electrostatic attraction of cations by commonly negative carbon-aerogel surfaces near neutral pH, improvement of anion uptake by positive groups, and additional aromatic and hydrogen-bonding interactions.
scope: Carbon aerogels used to remove dissolved contaminants.
conditions: Solution pH, adsorbate ionization, and surface functionalization affect the interactions.
caveats: No single surface modification is expected to optimize adsorption for every contaminant.
